title: Replace the catch-all CODEOWNERS in mongodb-mcp-server with path-specific ExampleCo owners
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server, default branch main), change .github/CODEOWNERS. Remove line 1 ('*          @mongodb-js/mcp-server-developers'). Add a catch-all line for an ExampleCo team, then entries for /deploy/, /.github/workflows/, /.github/CODEOWNERS, /src/ and /Dockerfile. Each entry names the team from the task 1 matrix and must come after the catch-all line, because the last match wins in CODEOWNERS. Deliver this as a pull request reviewed by someone other than the author (releaseProcess.approvalsRequired 1, selfApprovalAllowed false). The change is repository metadata only: no deployment window is needed, and it does not touch the running mcp-gateway service.
acceptanceCriteria: `git -C applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server show origin/main:.github/CODEOWNERS` shows entries for /deploy/, /.github/workflows/, /.github/CODEOWNERS and /src/, each naming an @OnFinance/ team, and no line contains @mongodb-js/.
The merged pull request shows an approval from a reviewer other than the author.

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-sdlc for example-co after the PR merges and a refresh-ctx re-fetch of mongodb-mcp-server. Expected: the SSDF PO.2.1 check finds path-specific ExampleCo owners for deploy/, .github/workflows/ and src/, and no longer reports the single catch-all upstream entry for this repository.

rootCause.description: CODEOWNERS was inherited unchanged from the upstream mongodb-js project when the repository was forked. Nobody reviewed it at onboarding, so the only code owner is a team ExampleCo does not control, and no owner is set for CI or deployment paths.
